+        shell_index += 1
+
+    for item in inputs:
+        if item == "-":
+            sources.append(
+                InputSource(
+                    label="stdin",
+                    content=stdin_cache.read(),
+                    absolute_path=None,
+                    relative_path="-",
+                    kind="stdin",
+                )
+            )
+            continue
+        expanded = expand_input(item, options.recursive, options.rotated)
+        if not expanded:
+            raise CliError(
+                1,
+                [f"  error: unable to open file: {item}", " reason: No such file or directory"],
+            )
+        for path in expanded:
+            if not os.path.exists(path):
+                raise CliError(
+                    1,
+                    [f"  error: unable to open file: {item}", " reason: No such file or directory"],
+                )
+            if os.path.isdir(path):
+                continue
+            content = read_path_text(path)
+            sources.append(
+                InputSource(
+                    label=os.path.abspath(path),
+                    content=content,
+                    absolute_path=os.path.abspath(path),
+                    relative_path=item,
+                    kind="file",
+                )
+            )
+
+    logs: List[LogRecord] = []
+    text_sources: List[TextSource] = []
+    for source in sources:
+        parsed_logs, parsed_text = parse_source(source)
+        if parsed_logs:
+            filtered_logs = apply_cutoffs(parsed_logs, source, options.since, options.until)
+            logs.extend(filtered_logs)
+        elif parsed_text is not None:
+            text_sources.append(parsed_text)
+
+    logs.sort(key=lambda rec: (rec.timestamp, rec.source_label, rec.raw_text))
+    assign_log_metadata(logs)
+    return logs, text_sources
+
+
+def default_log_paths() -> List[str]:
+    candidates = ["/var/log/messages", "/var/log/system.log", "/var/log/syslog"]
+    return [path for path in candidates if os.path.exists(path)]
+
+
+def expand_input(item: str, recursive: bool, rotated: bool) -> List[str]:
+    path = item
+    if not os.path.exists(path):
+        return []
+    if os.path.isdir(path):
+        if recursive:
+            results: List[str] = []
+            for root, dirs, files in os.walk(path):
+                dirs.sort()
+                for name in sorted(files):
+                    results.append(os.path.join(root, name))
+            return results
+        return [os.path.join(path, name) for name in sorted(os.listdir(path)) if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(path, name))]
+    results = [path]
+    if rotated:
+        parent = os.path.dirname(path) or "."
+        base = os.path.basename(path)
+        pattern = re.compile(re.escape(base) + r"\.\d+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9]+)?$")
+        for name in sorted(os.listdir(parent)):
+            if pattern.fullmatch(name):
+                results.append(os.path.join(parent, name))
+    return results
+
+
+def read_path_text(path: str) -> str:
+    if path.endswith(".gz"):
+        with gzip.open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
+            return handle.read()
+    if path.endswith(".bz2"):
+        with bz2.open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
+            return handle.read()
+    if path.endswith(".xz"):
+        with lzma.open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
+            return handle.read()
+    with open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
+        return handle.read()
+
+
+def run_shell_command(command: str) -> str:
+    proc = subprocess.run(
+        command,
+        shell=True,
+        executable="/bin/bash",
+        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
+        text=True,
+        encoding="utf-8",
+        errors="replace",
+        check=False,
+    )
+    return proc.stdout
+
+
+def parse_source(source: InputSource) -> tuple[List[LogRecord], Optional[TextSource]]:
+    lines = source.content.splitlines()
+    json_logs = parse_json_lines(lines, source)
+    if json_logs is not None:
+        return json_logs, None
+    syslog_logs = parse_line_logs(lines, source, "syslog")
+    if syslog_logs:
+        return syslog_logs, None
+    generic_logs = parse_line_logs(lines, source, "generic")
+    if generic_logs:
+        return generic_logs, None
+    return [], TextSource(label=source.label, lines=lines)
+
+
+def parse_json_lines(lines: Sequence[str], source: InputSource) -> Optional[List[LogRecord]]:
+    if not lines:
+        return None
+    records: List[LogRecord] = []
+    for line in lines:
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        try:
+            value = json.loads(line)
+        except json.JSONDecodeError:
+            return None
+        if not isinstance(value, dict):
+            return None
+        timestamp = None
+        for key in ("time", "timestamp", "@timestamp", "ts", "date"):
+            raw_value = value.get(key)
+            if isinstance(raw_value, str):
+                timestamp = parse_time_string(raw_value)
+                if timestamp is not None:
+                    break
+        if timestamp is None:
+            return None
+        level = normalize_level(value.get("level"))
+        body = extract_message_body(value)
+        display = f"{timestamp.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')} -[-] {level_to_label(level):<8} {body}"
+        records.append(
+            LogRecord(
+                source_kind="json",
+                source_label=source.label,
+                source_path=source.absolute_path,
+                format_name="json",
+                timestamp=timestamp,
+                display_text=display,
+                raw_text=display,
+                body=body,
+                level=level,
+                msg_format=body,
+                msg_values="null",
+                tokens=body_tokens(body),
+            )
+        )
+    return records
+
+
+def extract_message_body(value: dict) -> str:
+    for key in ("msg", "message", "body", "text"):
+        raw_value = value.get(key)
+        if raw_value is not None:
+            return str(raw_value)
+    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True)
+
+
+def normalize_level(value: object) -> str:
+    if value is None:
+        return "info"
+    raw = str(value).strip().lower()
+    return {
+        "warn": "warning",
+        "warning": "warning",
+        "err": "error",
+        "error": "error",
+        "debug": "debug",
+        "trace": "trace",
+        "info": "info",
+    }.get(raw, raw or "info")
+
+
+def level_to_label(level: str) -> str:
+    return {
+        "info": "INFO",
+        "warning": "WARNING",
+        "error": "ERROR",
+        "debug": "DEBUG",
+        "trace": "TRACE",
+        "unknown": "UNKNOWN",
+    }.get(level, level.upper())
+
+
+def parse_line_logs(lines: Sequence[str], source: InputSource, kind: str) -> List[LogRecord]:
+    matcher = parse_syslog_line if kind == "syslog" else parse_generic_line
+    records: List[LogRecord] = []
+    current: Optional[LogRecord] = None
+    matched_any = False
+    for line in lines:
+        parsed = matcher(line)
+        if parsed is None:
+            if current is not None and line:
+                current.display_text += "\n" + line
+                current.raw_text += "\n" + line
+                current.body += "\n" + line
+            else:
+                return []
+            continue
+        matched_any = True
+        timestamp, body, level = parsed
+        current = LogRecord(
+            source_kind=kind,
+            source_label=source.label,
+            source_path=source.absolute_path,
+            format_name=kind,
+            timestamp=timestamp,
+            display_text=line,
+            raw_text=line,
+            body=body,
+            level=level,
+            msg_format=body,
+            msg_values="null",
+            tokens=body_tokens(body),
+        )
+        records.append(current)
+    return records if matched_any else []
+
+
+def parse_generic_line(line: str) -> Optional[tuple[datetime, str, str]]:
+    match = ISO_RE.match(line)
+    if not match:
+        return None
+    timestamp = parse_time_string(match.group("ts"))
+    if timestamp is None:
+        return None
+    body = match.group("body")
+    return timestamp, body, "unknown"
+
+
+def parse_syslog_line(line: str) -> Optional[tuple[datetime, str, str]]:
+    match = SYSLOG_RE.match(line)
+    if not match:
+        return None
+    month = MONTHS.get(match.group("month"))
+    if month is None:
+        return None
+    today = date.today()
+    timestamp = datetime(
+        today.year,
+        month,
+        int(match.group("day")),
+        int(match.group("hour")),
+        int(match.group("minute")),
+        int(match.group("second")),
+    )
+    body = match.group("body")
+    if ": " in body:
+        body = body.split(": ", 1)[1]
+    return timestamp, body, "info"
+
+
+def body_tokens(body: str) -> List[Optional[str]]:
+    tokens: List[str] = []
+    ip_matches = re.findall(r"\b\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}\b", body)
+    if ip_matches:
+        tokens.extend(ip_matches)
+    tokens.extend(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]+", body))
+    unique: List[Optional[str]] = []
+    for token in tokens:
+        if token not in unique:
+            unique.append(token)
+        if len(unique) >= 10:
+            break
+    while len(unique) < 10:
+        unique.append(None)
+    return unique
+
+
+def apply_cutoffs(
+    records: List[LogRecord],
+    source: InputSource,
+    since: Optional[datetime],
+    until: Optional[datetime],
+) -> List[LogRecord]:
+    if since is None and until is None:
+        return records
+    kept = [record for record in records if in_cutoff(record.timestamp, since, until)]
+    if kept:
+        return kept
+    if source.kind != "file":
+        return []
+    mtime = datetime.fromtimestamp(os.path.getmtime(source.absolute_path or "."))
+    lines = [
+        f"  error: unable to open file: {source.label}",
+        f" reason: file contents are out-of-range of time cutoffs “{source.label}”",
+        f" |        = note: File time range is “{mtime.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')}” to “{mtime.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')}”",
+    ]
+    if since is not None:
+        lines.append(f" |        = note: Minimum time cutoff is “{since.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')}”")
+    if until is not None:
+        lines.append(f" |        = note: Maximum time cutoff is “{until.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')}”")
+    raise CliError(1, lines)
+
+
+def in_cutoff(timestamp: datetime, since: Optional[datetime], until: Optional[datetime]) -> bool:
+    if since is not None and timestamp < since:
+        return False
+    if until is not None and timestamp > until:
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def assign_log_metadata(records: List[LogRecord]) -> None:
+    prev: Optional[datetime] = None
+    for record in records:
+        if prev is None:
+            idle = 0
+        else:
+            idle = int((record.timestamp - prev).total_seconds() * 1000)
+            if idle < 0:
+                idle = 0
+        record.idle_msecs = idle  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
+        prev = record.timestamp
+
+
+def default_view(logs: Sequence[LogRecord], text_sources: Sequence[TextSource]) -> str:
+    if logs:
+        return "log"
+    if text_sources:
+        return "text"
+    return "empty"
+
+
+def run_command(spec: CommandSpec, state: State, stdin_cache: StdinCache) -> None:
+    raw = spec.raw
+    if not raw:
+        return
+    if raw.startswith("|"):
+        run_script(raw[1:], spec.origins, state, stdin_cache)
+        return
+    if raw.startswith(":"):
+        run_builtin(raw[1:].strip(), spec.origins, state)
+        return
+    if raw.startswith(";"):
+        run_sql(raw[1:].strip(), spec.origins, state)
+        return
+    raise CommandAbort([f"  error: unknown command: “{raw}”"])
+
+
+def run_script(path: str, origins: List[Origin], state: State, stdin_cache: StdinCache) -> None:
+    if path == "-":
+        content = stdin_cache.read()
+        script_label = "-"
+    else:
+        if not os.path.exists(path):
+            raise CommandAbort(
+                [
+                    f"  error: unknown script -- {path} -- file not found",
+                    f" --> {origins[-1].label}",
+                    f" | {origins[-1].snippet:<40}",
+                ]
+            )
+        content = Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
+        script_label = path
+    for lineno, line in enumerate(content.splitlines(), start=1):
+        stripped = line.strip()
+        if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#"):
+            continue
+        child = CommandSpec(raw=stripped, origins=origins + [Origin(f"{script_label}:{lineno}", stripped)])
+        run_command(child, state, stdin_cache)
+
+
+def run_builtin(command: str, origins: List[Origin], state: State) -> None:
+    if command == "help":
+        state.active_view = "help"
+        state.query_result = None
+        state.explicit_output = None
+        return
+    if command.startswith("switch-to-view "):
+        target = command.split(None, 1)[1].strip()
+        if target == "text":
+            state.active_view = "text"
+        elif target == "log":
+            state.active_view = "log"
+        else:
+            raise CommandAbort([f"  error: unknown command: “switch-to-view {target}”"])
+        state.query_result = None
+        state.explicit_output = None
+        return
+    if command.startswith("filter-in "):
+        pattern = command.split(None, 1)[1]
+        try:
+            compiled = re.compile(pattern)
+        except re.error as exc:
+            reason = regex_reason(str(exc))
+            pointer = "^ " + reason if reason else "^"
+            raise CommandAbort(
+                [
+                    f"  error: “{pattern}” is not a valid regular expression",
+                    f" reason: {reason}",
+                    " --> pattern",
+                    f" | {pattern:<44}",
+                    f" |  {pointer}",
+                    " = help: :filter-in pattern",
+                    "         ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
+                    "           Only show lines that match the given regular expression in the",
+                    "           current view",
+                ]
+            )
+        if state.active_view == "text":
+            state.text_filters.append(compiled)
+        else:
+            state.log_filters.append(compiled)
+        state.query_result = None
+        state.explicit_output = None
+        return
+    if command.startswith("write-csv-to "):
+        if state.query_result is None:
+            raise write_query_error("csv", origins[-1])
+        path = command.split(None, 1)[1].strip()
+        output = render_csv(state.query_result)
+        if path == "-":
+            state.explicit_output = output
+            state.active_view = "explicit"
+        else:
+            Path(path).write_text(output, encoding="utf-8")
+            state.explicit_output = ""
+            state.active_view = "explicit"
+        return
+    if command.startswith("write-json-to "):
+        if state.query_result is None:
+            raise write_query_error("json", origins[-1])
+        path = command.split(None, 1)[1].strip()
+        output = render_json(state.query_result)
+        if path == "-":
+            state.explicit_output = output
+            state.active_view = "explicit"
+        else:
+            Path(path).write_text(output, encoding="utf-8")
+            state.explicit_output = ""
+            state.active_view = "explicit"
+        return
+    if command.startswith("write-to "):
+        origin = origins[-1]
+        raise CommandAbort(
+            [
+                "  error: no lines marked to write, use 'm' to mark lines",
+                f" --> {origin.label}",
+                f" | {origin.snippet:<40}",
+                " = help: :write-to [--anonymize] path",
+                "         ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
+                "           Overwrite the given file with any marked lines in the current view",
+            ]
+        )
+    raise CommandAbort([f"  error: unknown command: “{command}”"])
+
+
+def regex_reason(message: str) -> str:
+    if "unterminated character set" in message:
+        return "missing terminating ] for character class"
+    return message
+
+
+def write_query_error(kind: str, origin: Origin) -> CommandAbort:
+    return CommandAbort(
+        [
+            "  error: no query result to write, use ';' to execute a query",
+            f" --> {origin.label}",
+            f" | {origin.snippet:<40}",
+            f" = help: :write-{kind}-to [--anonymize] path",
+            "         ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
+            f"           Write SQL results to the given file in {kind.upper()} format" if kind == "csv"
+            else f"           Write SQL results to the given file in {kind.upper()} format",
+        ]
+    )
+
+
+def run_sql(query: str, origins: List[Origin], state: State) -> None:
+    if query == ".schema":
+        state.explicit_output = render_schema(state)
+        state.active_view = "explicit"
+        state.query_result = None
+        return
+    connection = build_sqlite(state)
+    try:
+        cursor = connection.execute(query)
+    except sqlite3.Error as exc:
+        lines = ["  error: failed to compile SQL statement", f" reason: {exc}"]
+        for origin in origins:
+            lines.append(f" --> {origin.label}")
+            lines.append(f" | {origin.snippet:<40}")
+        raise CommandAbort(lines)
+    rows = cursor.fetchall()
+    columns = [description[0] for description in cursor.description or []]
+    state.query_result = QueryResult(columns=columns, rows=rows)
+    state.explicit_output = None
+    state.active_view = "query"
+
+
+def visible_logs(state: State) -> List[LogRecord]:
+    records = list(state.logs)
+    for regex in state.log_filters:
+        records = [record for record in records if regex.search(record.display_text)]
+    return records
+
+
+def visible_text_lines(state: State) -> List[str]:
+    if not state.text_sources:
+        return []
+    lines = list(state.text_sources[-1].lines)
+    for regex in state.text_filters:
+        lines = [line for line in lines if regex.search(line)]
+    return lines
+
+
+def build_sqlite(state: State) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    connection = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
+    connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
+    connection.execute(
+        """
+        CREATE TABLE all_logs (
+            log_line INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+            log_time TEXT,
+            log_level TEXT,
+            log_msg_format TEXT,
+            log_msg_values TEXT,
+            log_msg_src TEXT,
+            log_stack_trace TEXT,
+            log_part TEXT,
+            log_idle_msecs INTEGER,
+            log_mark INTEGER,
+            log_comment TEXT,
+            log_tags TEXT,
+            log_annotations TEXT,
+            log_filters TEXT,
+            log_path TEXT,
+            log_text TEXT,
+            log_body TEXT,
+            col_0 TEXT,
+            col_1 TEXT,
+            col_2 TEXT,
+            col_3 TEXT,
+            col_4 TEXT,
+            col_5 TEXT,
+            col_6 TEXT,
+            col_7 TEXT,
+            col_8 TEXT,
+            col_9 TEXT
+        )
+        """
+    )
+    connection.execute(
+        """
+        CREATE TABLE generic_log (
+            log_line INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+            log_time TEXT,
+            log_level TEXT,
+            log_part TEXT,
+            log_idle_msecs INTEGER,
+            log_mark INTEGER,
+            log_comment TEXT,
+            log_tags TEXT,
+            log_annotations TEXT,
+            log_filters TEXT,
+            log_path TEXT,
+            log_text TEXT,
+            log_body TEXT,
+            col_0 TEXT,
+            col_1 TEXT,
+            col_2 TEXT,
+            col_3 TEXT,
+            col_4 TEXT,
+            col_5 TEXT,
+            col_6 TEXT,
+            col_7 TEXT,
+            col_8 TEXT,
+            col_9 TEXT
+        )
+        """
+    )
+    connection.execute(
+        """
+        CREATE TABLE syslog_log (
+            log_line INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+            log_time TEXT,
+            log_level TEXT,
+            log_part TEXT,
+            log_idle_msecs INTEGER,
+            log_mark INTEGER,
+            log_comment TEXT,
+            log_tags TEXT,
+            log_annotations TEXT,
+            log_filters TEXT,
+            log_path TEXT,
+            log_text TEXT,
+            log_body TEXT,
+            col_0 TEXT,
+            col_1 TEXT,
+            col_2 TEXT,
+            col_3 TEXT,
+            col_4 TEXT,
+            col_5 TEXT,
+            col_6 TEXT,
+            col_7 TEXT,
+            col_8 TEXT,
+            col_9 TEXT
+        )
+        """
+    )
+    filtered = visible_logs(state)
+    for index, record in enumerate(filtered):
+        values = log_row(index, record)
+        connection.execute(
+            """
+            INSERT INTO all_logs VALUES (
+                ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
+                ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
+            )
+            """,
+            values,
+        )
+        if record.format_name == "generic":
+            connection.execute(
+                """
+                INSERT INTO generic_log VALUES (
+                    ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
+                )
+                """,
+                generic_row(index, record),
+            )
+        elif record.format_name == "syslog":
+            connection.execute(
+                """
+                INSERT INTO syslog_log VALUES (
+                    ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
+                )
+                """,
+                generic_row(index, record),
+            )
+    if filtered:
+        connection.execute("CREATE VIEW logline AS SELECT * FROM all_logs ORDER BY log_line LIMIT 1")
+    return connection
+
+
+def log_row(index: int, record: LogRecord) -> tuple:
+    return (
+        index,
+        record.timestamp.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f"),
+        record.level,
+        record.msg_format,
+        record.msg_values,
+        None,
+        None,
+        None,
+        getattr(record, "idle_msecs", 0),
+        0,
+        None,
+        None,
+        None,
+        None,
+        record.source_label,
+        record.display_text,
+        record.body,
+        *record.tokens,
+    )
+
+
+def generic_row(index: int, record: LogRecord) -> tuple:
+    return (
+        index,
+        record.timestamp.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f"),
+        record.level,
+        None,
+        getattr(record, "idle_msecs", 0),
+        0,
+        None,
+        None,
+        None,
+        None,
+        record.source_label,
+        record.display_text,
+        record.body,
+        *record.tokens,
+    )
+
+
+def render_schema(state: State) -> str:
+    connection = build_sqlite(state)
+    rows = connection.execute(
+        "SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE sql IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name"
+    ).fetchall()
+    return "\n".join(row[0] + ";" for row in rows) + ("\n" if rows else "")
+
+
+def render_state(state: State) -> str:
+    if state.active_view == "explicit":
+        return state.explicit_output or ""
+    if state.active_view == "help":
+        return state.help_text
+    if state.active_view == "query":
+        return render_query_result(state.query_result or QueryResult([], []))

def parse_time_string(value: str) -> Optional[datetime]:
    raw = value.strip()
    if not raw:
        return None
    if re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", raw):
        try:
            return datetime.strptime(raw, "%Y-%m-%d")
        except ValueError:
            return None
    candidate = raw.replace("Z", "+00:00")
    try:
        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(candidate)
    except ValueError:
        return None
    if parsed.tzinfo is not None:
        parsed = parsed.astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)
    return parsed

def default_log_paths() -> List[str]:
    candidates = ["/var/log/messages", "/var/log/system.log", "/var/log/syslog"]
    return [path for path in candidates if os.path.exists(path)]


def expand_input(item: str, recursive: bool, rotated: bool) -> List[str]:
    path = item
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return []
    if os.path.isdir(path):
        if recursive:
            results: List[str] = []
            for root, dirs, files in os.walk(path):
                dirs.sort()
                for name in sorted(files):
                    results.append(os.path.join(root, name))
            return results
        return [os.path.join(path, name) for name in sorted(os.listdir(path)) if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(path, name))]
    results = [path]
    if rotated:
        parent = os.path.dirname(path) or "."
        base = os.path.basename(path)
        pattern = re.compile(re.escape(base) + r"\.\d+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9]+)?$")
        for name in sorted(os.listdir(parent)):
            if pattern.fullmatch(name):
                results.append(os.path.join(parent, name))
    return results


def read_path_text(path: str) -> str:
    if path.endswith(".gz"):
        with gzip.open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
            return handle.read()
    if path.endswith(".bz2"):
        with bz2.open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
            return handle.read()
    if path.endswith(".xz"):
        with lzma.open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
            return handle.read()
    with open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
        return handle.read()

    proc = subprocess.run(
        command,
        shell=True,
        executable="/bin/bash",
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
        text=True,
        encoding="utf-8",
        errors="replace",
        check=False,
    )
    return proc.stdout

    lines = source.content.splitlines()

    if json_logs is not None:
        return json_logs, None
    syslog_logs = parse_line_logs(lines, source, "syslog")
    if syslog_logs:
        return syslog_logs, None
    generic_logs = parse_line_logs(lines, source, "generic")
    if generic_logs:
        return generic_logs, None
    return [], TextSource(label=source.label, lines=lines)

                source_kind="json",
                source_label=source.label,
                source_path=source.absolute_path,
                format_name="json",
                timestamp=timestamp,
                display_text=display,
                raw_text=display,
                body=body,
                level=level,
                msg_format=body,
                msg_values="null",
                tokens=body_tokens(body),
            )
        )
    return records


def extract_message_body(value: dict) -> str:
    for key in ("msg", "message", "body", "text"):
        raw_value = value.get(key)
        if raw_value is not None:
            return str(raw_value)
    return json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True)


def normalize_level(value: object) -> str:
    if value is None:
        return "info"
    raw = str(value).strip().lower()
    return {
        "warn": "warning",
        "warning": "warning",
        "err": "error",
        "error": "error",
        "debug": "debug",
        "trace": "trace",
        "info": "info",
    }.get(raw, raw or "info")


def level_to_label(level: str) -> str:
    return {
        "info": "INFO",
        "warning": "WARNING",
        "error": "ERROR",
        "debug": "DEBUG",
        "trace": "TRACE",
        "unknown": "UNKNOWN",
    }.get(level, level.upper())


def parse_line_logs(lines: Sequence[str], source: InputSource, kind: str) -> List[LogRecord]:
    matcher = parse_syslog_line if kind == "syslog" else parse_generic_line
    records: List[LogRecord] = []
    current: Optional[LogRecord] = None
    matched_any = False
    for line in lines:
        parsed = matcher(line)
        if parsed is None:
            if current is not None and line:
                current.display_text += "\n" + line
                current.raw_text += "\n" + line
                current.body += "\n" + line
            else:
                return []
            continue
        matched_any = True
        timestamp, body, level = parsed
        current = LogRecord(
            source_kind=kind,
            source_label=source.label,
            source_path=source.absolute_path,
            format_name=kind,
            timestamp=timestamp,
            display_text=line,
            raw_text=line,
            body=body,
            level=level,
            msg_format=body,
            msg_values="null",
            tokens=body_tokens(body),
        )
        records.append(current)
    return records if matched_any else []


def parse_generic_line(line: str) -> Optional[tuple[datetime, str, str]]:
    match = ISO_RE.match(line)
    if not match:
        return None
    timestamp = parse_time_string(match.group("ts"))
    if timestamp is None:
        return None
    body = match.group("body")
    return timestamp, body, "unknown"


def parse_syslog_line(line: str) -> Optional[tuple[datetime, str, str]]:
    match = SYSLOG_RE.match(line)
    if not match:
        return None
    month = MONTHS.get(match.group("month"))
    if month is None:
        return None
    today = date.today()
    timestamp = datetime(
        today.year,
        month,
        int(match.group("day")),
        int(match.group("hour")),
        int(match.group("minute")),
        int(match.group("second")),
    )
    body = match.group("body")
    if ": " in body:
        body = body.split(": ", 1)[1]
    return timestamp, body, "info"


def body_tokens(body: str) -> List[Optional[str]]:
    tokens: List[str] = []
    ip_matches = re.findall(r"\b\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}\b", body)
    if ip_matches:
        tokens.extend(ip_matches)
    tokens.extend(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]+", body))
    unique: List[Optional[str]] = []
    for token in tokens:
        if token not in unique:
            unique.append(token)
        if len(unique) >= 10:
            break
    while len(unique) < 10:
        unique.append(None)
    return unique


def apply_cutoffs(
    records: List[LogRecord],
    source: InputSource,
    since: Optional[datetime],
    until: Optional[datetime],
) -> List[LogRecord]:
    if since is None and until is None:
        return records
    kept = [record for record in records if in_cutoff(record.timestamp, since, until)]
    if kept:
        return kept
    if source.kind != "file":
        return []
    mtime = datetime.fromtimestamp(os.path.getmtime(source.absolute_path or "."))
    lines = [
        f"  error: unable to open file: {source.label}",
        f" reason: file contents are out-of-range of time cutoffs “{source.label}”",
        f" |        = note: File time range is “{mtime.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')}” to “{mtime.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')}”",
    ]
    if since is not None:
        lines.append(f" |        = note: Minimum time cutoff is “{since.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')}”")
    if until is not None:
        lines.append(f" |        = note: Maximum time cutoff is “{until.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')}”")
    raise CliError(1, lines)


def in_cutoff(timestamp: datetime, since: Optional[datetime], until: Optional[datetime]) -> bool:
    if since is not None and timestamp < since:
        return False
    if until is not None and timestamp > until:
        return False
    return True


def assign_log_metadata(records: List[LogRecord]) -> None:
    prev: Optional[datetime] = None
    for record in records:
        if prev is None:
            idle = 0
        else:
            idle = int((record.timestamp - prev).total_seconds() * 1000)
            if idle < 0:
                idle = 0
        record.idle_msecs = idle  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
        prev = record.timestamp


def default_view(logs: Sequence[LogRecord], text_sources: Sequence[TextSource]) -> str:
    if logs:
        return "log"
    if text_sources:
        return "text"
    return "empty"


def run_command(spec: CommandSpec, state: State, stdin_cache: StdinCache) -> None:
    raw = spec.raw
    if not raw:
        return
    if raw.startswith("|"):
        run_script(raw[1:], spec.origins, state, stdin_cache)
        return
    if raw.startswith(":"):
        run_builtin(raw[1:].strip(), spec.origins, state)
        return
    if raw.startswith(";"):
        run_sql(raw[1:].strip(), spec.origins, state)
        return
    raise CommandAbort([f"  error: unknown command: “{raw}”"])


def run_script(path: str, origins: List[Origin], state: State, stdin_cache: StdinCache) -> None:
    if path == "-":
        content = stdin_cache.read()
        script_label = "-"
    else:
        if not os.path.exists(path):
            raise CommandAbort(
                [
                    f"  error: unknown script -- {path} -- file not found",
                    f" --> {origins[-1].label}",
                    f" | {origins[-1].snippet:<40}",
                ]
            )
        content = Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        script_label = path
    for lineno, line in enumerate(content.splitlines(), start=1):
        stripped = line.strip()
        if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#"):
            continue
        child = CommandSpec(raw=stripped, origins=origins + [Origin(f"{script_label}:{lineno}", stripped)])
        run_command(child, state, stdin_cache)


def run_builtin(command: str, origins: List[Origin], state: State) -> None:
    if command == "help":
        state.active_view = "help"
        state.query_result = None
        state.explicit_output = None
        return
    if command.startswith("switch-to-view "):
        target = command.split(None, 1)[1].strip()
        if target == "text":
            state.active_view = "text"
        elif target == "log":
            state.active_view = "log"
        else:
            raise CommandAbort([f"  error: unknown command: “switch-to-view {target}”"])
        state.query_result = None
        state.explicit_output = None
        return
    if command.startswith("filter-in "):
        pattern = command.split(None, 1)[1]
        try:
            compiled = re.compile(pattern)
        except re.error as exc:
            reason = regex_reason(str(exc))
            pointer = "^ " + reason if reason else "^"
            raise CommandAbort(
                [
                    f"  error: “{pattern}” is not a valid regular expression",
                    f" reason: {reason}",
                    " --> pattern",
                    f" | {pattern:<44}",
                    f" |  {pointer}",
                    " = help: :filter-in pattern",
                    "         ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
                    "           Only show lines that match the given regular expression in the",
                    "           current view",
                ]
            )
        if state.active_view == "text":
            state.text_filters.append(compiled)
        else:
            state.log_filters.append(compiled)
        state.query_result = None
        state.explicit_output = None
        return
    if command.startswith("write-csv-to "):
        if state.query_result is None:
            raise write_query_error("csv", origins[-1])
        path = command.split(None, 1)[1].strip()
        output = render_csv(state.query_result)
        if path == "-":
            state.explicit_output = output
            state.active_view = "explicit"
        else:
            Path(path).write_text(output, encoding="utf-8")
            state.explicit_output = ""
            state.active_view = "explicit"
        return
    if command.startswith("write-json-to "):
        if state.query_result is None:
            raise write_query_error("json", origins[-1])
        path = command.split(None, 1)[1].strip()
        output = render_json(state.query_result)
        if path == "-":
            state.explicit_output = output
            state.active_view = "explicit"
        else:
            Path(path).write_text(output, encoding="utf-8")
            state.explicit_output = ""
            state.active_view = "explicit"
        return
    if command.startswith("write-to "):
        origin = origins[-1]
        raise CommandAbort(
            [
                "  error: no lines marked to write, use 'm' to mark lines",
                f" --> {origin.label}",
                f" | {origin.snippet:<40}",
                " = help: :write-to [--anonymize] path",
                "         ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
                "           Overwrite the given file with any marked lines in the current view",
            ]
        )
    raise CommandAbort([f"  error: unknown command: “{command}”"])


def regex_reason(message: str) -> str:
    if "unterminated character set" in message:
        return "missing terminating ] for character class"
    return message


def write_query_error(kind: str, origin: Origin) -> CommandAbort:
    return CommandAbort(
        [
            "  error: no query result to write, use ';' to execute a query",
            f" --> {origin.label}",
            f" | {origin.snippet:<40}",
            f" = help: :write-{kind}-to [--anonymize] path",
            "         ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
            f"           Write SQL results to the given file in {kind.upper()} format" if kind == "csv"
            else f"           Write SQL results to the given file in {kind.upper()} format",
        ]
    )


def run_sql(query: str, origins: List[Origin], state: State) -> None:
    if query == ".schema":
        state.explicit_output = render_schema(state)
        state.active_view = "explicit"
        state.query_result = None
        return
    connection = build_sqlite(state)
    try:
        cursor = connection.execute(query)
    except sqlite3.Error as exc:
        lines = ["  error: failed to compile SQL statement", f" reason: {exc}"]
        for origin in origins:
            lines.append(f" --> {origin.label}")
            lines.append(f" | {origin.snippet:<40}")
        raise CommandAbort(lines)
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    columns = [description[0] for description in cursor.description or []]
    state.query_result = QueryResult(columns=columns, rows=rows)
    state.explicit_output = None
    state.active_view = "query"


def visible_logs(state: State) -> List[LogRecord]:
    records = list(state.logs)
    for regex in state.log_filters:
        records = [record for record in records if regex.search(record.display_text)]
    return records


def visible_text_lines(state: State) -> List[str]:
    if not state.text_sources:
        return []
    lines = list(state.text_sources[-1].lines)
    for regex in state.text_filters:
        lines = [line for line in lines if regex.search(line)]
    return lines


def build_sqlite(state: State) -> sqlite3.Connection:
    connection = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
    connection.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    connection.execute(
        """
        CREATE TABLE all_logs (
            log_line INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            log_time TEXT,
            log_level TEXT,
            log_msg_format TEXT,
            log_msg_values TEXT,
            log_msg_src TEXT,
            log_stack_trace TEXT,
            log_part TEXT,
            log_idle_msecs INTEGER,
            log_mark INTEGER,
            log_comment TEXT,
            log_tags TEXT,
            log_annotations TEXT,
            log_filters TEXT,
            log_path TEXT,
            log_text TEXT,
            log_body TEXT,
            col_0 TEXT,
            col_1 TEXT,
            col_2 TEXT,
            col_3 TEXT,
            col_4 TEXT,
            col_5 TEXT,
            col_6 TEXT,
            col_7 TEXT,
            col_8 TEXT,
            col_9 TEXT
        )
        """
    )
    connection.execute(
        """
        CREATE TABLE generic_log (
            log_line INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            log_time TEXT,
            log_level TEXT,
            log_part TEXT,
            log_idle_msecs INTEGER,
            log_mark INTEGER,
            log_comment TEXT,
            log_tags TEXT,
            log_annotations TEXT,
            log_filters TEXT,
            log_path TEXT,
            log_text TEXT,
            log_body TEXT,
            col_0 TEXT,
            col_1 TEXT,
            col_2 TEXT,
            col_3 TEXT,
            col_4 TEXT,
            col_5 TEXT,
            col_6 TEXT,
            col_7 TEXT,
            col_8 TEXT,
            col_9 TEXT
        )
        """
    )
    connection.execute(
        """
        CREATE TABLE syslog_log (
            log_line INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
            log_time TEXT,
            log_level TEXT,
            log_part TEXT,
            log_idle_msecs INTEGER,
            log_mark INTEGER,
            log_comment TEXT,
            log_tags TEXT,
            log_annotations TEXT,
            log_filters TEXT,
            log_path TEXT,
            log_text TEXT,
            log_body TEXT,
            col_0 TEXT,
            col_1 TEXT,
            col_2 TEXT,
            col_3 TEXT,
            col_4 TEXT,
            col_5 TEXT,
            col_6 TEXT,
            col_7 TEXT,
            col_8 TEXT,
            col_9 TEXT
        )
        """
    )
    filtered = visible_logs(state)
    for index, record in enumerate(filtered):
        values = log_row(index, record)
        connection.execute(
            """
            INSERT INTO all_logs VALUES (
                ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
                ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
            )
            """,
            values,
        )
        if record.format_name == "generic":
            connection.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO generic_log VALUES (
                    ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
                )
                """,
                generic_row(index, record),
            )
        elif record.format_name == "syslog":
            connection.execute(
                """
                INSERT INTO syslog_log VALUES (
                    ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
                )
                """,
                generic_row(index, record),
            )
    if filtered:
        connection.execute("CREATE VIEW logline AS SELECT * FROM all_logs ORDER BY log_line LIMIT 1")
    return connection


def log_row(index: int, record: LogRecord) -> tuple:
    return (
        index,
        record.timestamp.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f"),
        record.level,
        record.msg_format,
        record.msg_values,
        None,
        None,
        None,
        getattr(record, "idle_msecs", 0),
        0,
        None,
        None,
        None,
        None,
        record.source_label,
        record.display_text,
        record.body,
        *record.tokens,
    )


def generic_row(index: int, record: LogRecord) -> tuple:
    return (
        index,
        record.timestamp.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f"),
        record.level,
        None,
        getattr(record, "idle_msecs", 0),
        0,
        None,
        None,
        None,
        None,
        record.source_label,
        record.display_text,
        record.body,
        *record.tokens,
    )


def render_schema(state: State) -> str:
    connection = build_sqlite(state)
    rows = connection.execute(
        "SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE sql IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name"
    ).fetchall()
    return "\n".join(row[0] + ";" for row in rows) + ("\n" if rows else "")


def render_state(state: State) -> str:
    if state.active_view == "explicit":
        return state.explicit_output or ""
    if state.active_view == "help":
        return state.help_text
    if state.active_view == "query":
        return render_query_result(state.query_result or QueryResult([], []))
    if state.active_view == "text":
        lines = visible_text_lines(state)
        return ("\n".join(lines) + ("\n" if lines else ""))
    if state.active_view == "log":
        records = visible_logs(state)
        if not records:
            return ""
        return "\n".join(record.display_text for record in records) + "\n"
    return ""


def render_query_result(result: QueryResult) -> str:
    if not result.columns:
        return ""
    widths = [len(column) for column in result.columns]
    formatted_rows: List[List[str]] = []
    numeric_flags = [True] * len(result.columns)
    for row in result.rows:
        cells: List[str] = []
        for index, value in enumerate(row):
            cell, is_numeric = format_cell(value)
            widths[index] = max(widths[index], len(cell))
            numeric_flags[index] = numeric_flags[index] and is_numeric
            cells.append(cell)
        formatted_rows.append(cells)
    header = " ".join(column.ljust(widths[index]) for index, column in enumerate(result.columns))
    lines = [header]
    for row in formatted_rows:
        lines.append(
            " ".join(
                row[index].rjust(widths[index]) if numeric_flags[index] else row[index].ljust(widths[index])
                for index in range(len(row))
            )
        )
    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"


def format_cell(value: object) -> tuple[str, bool]:
    if value is None:
        return "<NULL>", False
    if isinstance(value, int):
        return str(value), True
    if isinstance(value, float):
        return str(value), True
    return str(value), False


def render_csv(result: QueryResult) -> str:
    output = io.StringIO()
    writer = csv.writer(output, lineterminator="\n")
    writer.writerow(result.columns)
    writer.writerows(result.rows)
    return output.getvalue()


def render_json(result: QueryResult) -> str:
    data = [dict(zip(result.columns, row)) for row in result.rows]
    return json.dumps(data, indent=4) + "\n"


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main(sys.argv))

+    sources_to_open = list(options.inputs)
+    if not sources_to_open and not options.no_default and not options.internal_help and not options.commands and not options.shell_commands:
+        sources_to_open.extend(default_paths())
+
+    if not sources_to_open and not options.shell_commands and not options.internal_help and not options.commands and not options.check_config and not options.print_warnings:
+        raise CliError(
+            1,
+            [
+                "  error: nothing to do",
+                " reason: no files given or default files found",
+                " = help: use the “-N” option to open lnav without loading any files",
+            ],
+        )
+
+    for index, shell_command in enumerate(options.shell_commands):
+        input_sources.append(
+            InputSource(
+                label=f"sh-{index} {shell_command}",
+                content=run_shell_command(shell_command),
+                kind="shell",
+                absolute_path=None,
+                error_name=None,
+            )
+        )
+
+    for item in sources_to_open:
+        if item == "-":
+            input_sources.append(
+                InputSource("stdin", stdin_cache.read(), "stdin", None, None)
+            )
+            continue
+        paths = expand_input(item, options.recursive, options.rotated)
+        if not paths:
+            raise CliError(1, [f"  error: unable to open file: {item}", " reason: No such file or directory"])
+        for path in paths:
+            if not os.path.exists(path):
+                raise CliError(1, [f"  error: unable to open file: {item}", " reason: No such file or directory"])
+            if os.path.isdir(path):
+                continue
+            input_sources.append(
+                InputSource(
+                    label=os.path.abspath(path),
+                    content=read_text(path),
+                    kind="file",
+                    absolute_path=os.path.abspath(path),
+                    error_name=item,
+                )
+            )
+
+    logs: List[LogRecord] = []
+    text_sources: List[TextSource] = []
+    for source in input_sources:
+        parsed_logs, text_source = parse_source(source)
+        if parsed_logs:
+            logs.extend(apply_cutoffs(parsed_logs, source, options.since, options.until))
+        elif text_source is not None:
+            text_sources.append(text_source)
+
+    logs.sort(key=lambda record: (record.timestamp, record.source_label, record.display_text))
+    previous: Optional[datetime] = None
+    for record in logs:
+        record.idle_msecs = 0 if previous is None else max(0, int((record.timestamp - previous).total_seconds() * 1000))
+        previous = record.timestamp
+    return logs, text_sources
+
+
+def default_paths() -> List[str]:
+    return [path for path in ("/var/log/messages", "/var/log/syslog", "/var/log/system.log") if os.path.exists(path)]
+
+
+def expand_input(item: str, recursive: bool, rotated: bool) -> List[str]:
+    if not os.path.exists(item):
+        return []
+    if os.path.isdir(item):
+        if recursive:
+            results: List[str] = []
+            for root, dirs, files in os.walk(item):
+                dirs.sort()
+                for name in sorted(files):
+                    results.append(os.path.join(root, name))
+            return results
+        return [os.path.join(item, name) for name in sorted(os.listdir(item)) if os.path.isfile(os.path.join(item, name))]
+    results = [item]
+    if rotated:
+        parent = os.path.dirname(item) or "."
+        base = os.path.basename(item)
+        rotated_re = re.compile(re.escape(base) + r"\.\d+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9]+)?$")
+        for name in sorted(os.listdir(parent)):
+            if rotated_re.fullmatch(name):
+                results.append(os.path.join(parent, name))
+    return results
+
+
+def read_text(path: str) -> str:
+    if path.endswith(".gz"):
+        with gzip.open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
+            return handle.read()
+    if path.endswith(".bz2"):
+        with bz2.open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
+            return handle.read()
+    if path.endswith(".xz"):
+        with lzma.open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
+            return handle.read()
+    with open(path, "rt", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as handle:
+        return handle.read()
+
+
+def run_shell_command(command: str) -> str:
+    proc = subprocess.run(
+        command,
+        shell=True,
+        executable="/bin/bash",
+        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+        stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
+        text=True,
+        encoding="utf-8",
+        errors="replace",
+        check=False,
+    )
+    return proc.stdout
+
+
+def parse_source(source: InputSource) -> tuple[List[LogRecord], Optional[TextSource]]:
+    lines = source.content.splitlines()
+    json_logs = parse_json_lines(lines, source)
+    if json_logs is not None:
+        return json_logs, None
+    syslog_logs = parse_timestamped_lines(lines, source, "syslog")
+    if syslog_logs:
+        return syslog_logs, None
+    generic_logs = parse_timestamped_lines(lines, source, "generic")
+    if generic_logs:
+        return generic_logs, None
+    return [], TextSource(source.label, lines)
+
+
+def parse_json_lines(lines: Sequence[str], source: InputSource) -> Optional[List[LogRecord]]:
+    if not lines:
+        return None
+    records: List[LogRecord] = []
+    for line in lines:
+        if not line.strip():
+            continue
+        try:
+            payload = json.loads(line)
+        except json.JSONDecodeError:
+            return None
+        if not isinstance(payload, dict):
+            return None
+        timestamp = None
+        for key in ("time", "timestamp", "@timestamp", "ts", "date"):
+            value = payload.get(key)
+            if isinstance(value, str):
+                timestamp = parse_timestamp(value)
+                if timestamp is not None:
+                    break
+        if timestamp is None:
+            return None
+        body = extract_message(payload)
+        level = normalize_level(payload.get("level"))
+        display = f"{timestamp.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S')} -[-] {level_label(level):<8} {body}"
+        records.append(
+            LogRecord(
+                "json",
+                timestamp,
+                display,
+                body,
+                level,
+                source.label,
+                source.absolute_path,
+                extract_tokens(body),
+            )
+        )
+    return records
+
+
+def parse_timestamped_lines(lines: Sequence[str], source: InputSource, kind: str) -> List[LogRecord]:
+    parser = parse_syslog_line if kind == "syslog" else parse_generic_line
+    records: List[LogRecord] = []
+    current: Optional[LogRecord] = None
+    matched = False
+    for line in lines:
+        parsed = parser(line)
+        if parsed is None:
+            if current is not None and line:
+                current.display_text += "\n" + line
+                current.body += "\n" + line
+            else:
+                return []
+            continue
+        matched = True
+        timestamp, body, level = parsed
+        current = LogRecord(kind, timestamp, line, body, level, source.label, source.absolute_path, extract_tokens(body))
+        records.append(current)
+    return records if matched else []
+
+
+def parse_generic_line(line: str) -> Optional[tuple[datetime, str, str]]:
+    match = ISO_RE.match(line)
+    if not match:
+        return None
+    timestamp = parse_timestamp(match.group("stamp"))
+    if timestamp is None:
+        return None
+    return timestamp, match.group("body"), "unknown"
+
+
+def parse_syslog_line(line: str) -> Optional[tuple[datetime, str, str]]:
+    match = SYSLOG_RE.match(line)
+    if not match:
+        return None
+    month = MONTHS.get(match.group("month"))
+    if month is None:
+        return None
+    timestamp = datetime(
+        date.today().year,
+        month,
+        int(match.group("day")),
+        int(match.group("hour")),
+        int(match.group("minute")),
+        int(match.group("second")),
+    )
+    body = match.group("body")
+    if ": " in body:
+        body = body.split(": ", 1)[1]
+    return timestamp, body, "info"
+
+
+def parse_timestamp(value: str) -> Optional[datetime]:
+    raw = value.strip()
+    if not raw:
+        return None
+    if re.fullmatch(r"\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}", raw):
+        try:
+            return datetime.strptime(raw, "%Y-%m-%d")
+        except ValueError:
+            return None
+    candidate = raw.replace("Z", "+00:00")
+    if re.search(r"[+-]\d{4}$", candidate):
+        candidate = candidate[:-5] + candidate[-5:-2] + ":" + candidate[-2:]
+    try:
+        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(candidate)
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+    if parsed.tzinfo is not None:
+        parsed = parsed.astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)
+    return parsed
+
+
+def extract_message(payload: dict) -> str:
+    for key in ("msg", "message", "body", "text"):
+        if key in payload:
+            return str(payload[key])
+    return json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True)
+
+
+def normalize_level(value: object) -> str:
+    raw = "" if value is None else str(value).strip().lower()
+    return {
+        "warn": "warning",
+        "warning": "warning",
+        "err": "error",
+        "error": "error",
+        "debug": "debug",
+        "trace": "trace",
+        "info": "info",
+    }.get(raw, raw or "info")
+
+
+def level_label(level: str) -> str:
+    return {
+        "info": "INFO",
+        "warning": "WARNING",
+        "error": "ERROR",
+        "debug": "DEBUG",
+        "trace": "TRACE",
+        "unknown": "UNKNOWN",
+    }.get(level, level.upper())
+
+
+def extract_tokens(body: str) -> List[Optional[str]]:
+    tokens: List[str] = []
+    ips = re.findall(r"\b\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3}\b", body)
+    tokens.extend(ips)
+    tokens.extend(re.findall(r"[A-Za-z0-9_.:/-]+", body))
+    unique: List[Optional[str]] = []
+    for token in tokens:
+        if token not in unique:
+            unique.append(token)
+        if len(unique) >= 10:
+            break
+    while len(unique) < 10:
+        unique.append(None)
+    return unique
+
+
+def apply_cutoffs(records: List[LogRecord], source: InputSource, since: Optional[datetime], until: Optional[datetime]) -> List[LogRecord]:
+    if since is None and until is None:
+        return records
+    kept = [record for record in records if (since is None or record.timestamp >= since) and (until is None or record.timestamp <= until)]
+    if kept:
+        return kept
+    if source.kind != "file" or source.absolute_path is None:
+        return []
+    mtime = datetime.fromtimestamp(os.path.getmtime(source.absolute_path))
+    lines = [
+        f"  error: unable to open file: {source.absolute_path}",
+        f" reason: file contents are out-of-range of time cutoffs “{source.absolute_path}”",
+        f" |        = note: File time range is “{mtime.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')}” to “{mtime.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')}”",
+    ]
+    if since is not None:
+        lines.append(f" |        = note: Minimum time cutoff is “{since.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')}”")
+    if until is not None:
+        lines.append(f" |        = note: Maximum time cutoff is “{until.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f')}”")
+    raise CliError(1, lines)
+
+
+def default_view(logs: Sequence[LogRecord], text_sources: Sequence[TextSource]) -> str:
+    if logs:
+        return "log"
+    if text_sources:
+        return "text"
+    return "empty"
+
+
+def execute_command(spec: CommandSpec, state: State, stdin_cache: StdinCache) -> None:
+    if not spec.raw:
+        return
+    if spec.raw.startswith("|"):
+        execute_script(spec.raw[1:], spec.origins, state, stdin_cache)
+        return
+    if spec.raw.startswith(":"):
+        execute_builtin(spec.raw[1:].strip(), spec.origins, state)
+        return
+    if spec.raw.startswith(";"):
+        execute_sql(spec.raw[1:].strip(), spec.origins, state)
+        return
+    raise CommandAbort([f"  error: unknown command: “{spec.raw}”"])
+
+
+def execute_script(path: str, origins: List[Origin], state: State, stdin_cache: StdinCache) -> None:
+    if path == "-":
+        content = stdin_cache.read()
+        label = "-"
+    else:
+        if not os.path.exists(path):
+            raise CommandAbort(
+                [
+                    f"  error: unknown script -- {path} -- file not found",
+                    f" --> {origins[-1].label}",
+                    f" | {origins[-1].snippet:<40}",
+                ]
+            )
+        content = Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
+        label = path
+    for lineno, line in enumerate(content.splitlines(), start=1):
+        stripped = line.strip()
+        if not stripped or stripped.startswith("#"):
+            continue
+        execute_command(CommandSpec(stripped, origins + [Origin(f"{label}:{lineno}", stripped)]), state, stdin_cache)
+
+
+def execute_builtin(command: str, origins: List[Origin], state: State) -> None:
+    if command == "help":
+        state.active_view = "help"
+        state.query_result = None
+        state.explicit_output = None
+        return
+    if command.startswith("switch-to-view "):
+        target = command.split(None, 1)[1].strip()
+        if target == "text":
+            state.active_view = "text"
+        elif target == "log":
+            state.active_view = "log"
+        else:
+            raise CommandAbort([f"  error: unknown command: “switch-to-view {target}”"])
+        state.query_result = None
+        state.explicit_output = None
+        return
+    if command.startswith("filter-in "):
+        pattern = command.split(None, 1)[1]
+        try:
+            compiled = re.compile(pattern)
+        except re.error as exc:
+            reason = "missing terminating ] for character class" if "unterminated character set" in str(exc) else str(exc)
+            raise CommandAbort(
+                [
+                    f"  error: “{pattern}” is not a valid regular expression",
+                    f" reason: {reason}",
+                    " --> pattern",
+                    f" | {pattern:<44}",
+                    f" |  ^ {reason}",
+                    " = help: :filter-in pattern",
+                    "         ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
+                    "           Only show lines that match the given regular expression in the",
+                    "           current view",
+                ]
+            )
+        if state.active_view == "text":
+            state.text_filters.append(compiled)
+        else:
+            state.log_filters.append(compiled)
+        state.query_result = None
+        state.explicit_output = None
+        return
+    if command.startswith("write-csv-to "):
+        if state.query_result is None:
+            raise no_query_error("csv", origins[-1])
+        state.active_view = "explicit"
+        state.explicit_output = render_csv(state.query_result)
+        return
+    if command.startswith("write-json-to "):
+        if state.query_result is None:
+            raise no_query_error("json", origins[-1])
+        state.active_view = "explicit"
+        state.explicit_output = render_json(state.query_result)
+        return
+    if command.startswith("write-to "):
+        raise CommandAbort(
+            [
+                "  error: no lines marked to write, use 'm' to mark lines",
+                f" --> {origins[-1].label}",
+                f" | {origins[-1].snippet:<40}",
+                " = help: :write-to [--anonymize] path",
+                "         ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
+                "           Overwrite the given file with any marked lines in the current view",
+            ]
+        )
+    raise CommandAbort([f"  error: unknown command: “{command}”"])
+
+
+def no_query_error(kind: str, origin: Origin) -> CommandAbort:
+    return CommandAbort(
+        [
+            "  error: no query result to write, use ';' to execute a query",
+            f" --> {origin.label}",
+            f" | {origin.snippet:<40}",
+            f" = help: :write-{kind}-to [--anonymize] path",
+            "         ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════",
+            f"           Write SQL results to the given file in {kind.upper()} format",
+        ]
+    )
+
+
+def execute_sql(query: str, origins: List[Origin], state: State) -> None:
+    if query == ".schema":
+        state.active_view = "explicit"
+        state.explicit_output = render_schema(state)
+        state.query_result = None
+        return
+    db = build_db(state)
+    try:
+        cursor = db.execute(query)
+    except sqlite3.Error as exc:
+        lines = ["  error: failed to compile SQL statement", f" reason: {exc}"]
+        for origin in origins:
+            lines.append(f" --> {origin.label}")
+            lines.append(f" | {origin.snippet:<40}")
+        raise CommandAbort(lines)
+    rows = cursor.fetchall()
+    columns = [description[0] for description in cursor.description or []]
+    state.active_view = "query"
+    state.explicit_output = None
+    state.query_result = QueryResult(columns, rows)
+
+
+def visible_logs(state: State) -> List[LogRecord]:
+    records = list(state.logs)
+    for regex in state.log_filters:
+        records = [record for record in records if regex.search(record.display_text)]
+    return records
+
+
+def visible_text_lines(state: State) -> List[str]:
+    if not state.text_sources:
+        return []
+    lines = list(state.text_sources[-1].lines)
+    for regex in state.text_filters:
+        lines = [line for line in lines if regex.search(line)]
+    return lines
+
+
+def build_db(state: State) -> sqlite3.Connection:
+    db = sqlite3.connect(":memory:")
+    db.execute(
+        """
+        CREATE TABLE all_logs (
+            log_line INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+            log_time TEXT,
+            log_level TEXT,
+            log_msg_format TEXT,
+            log_msg_values TEXT,
+            log_msg_src TEXT,
+            log_stack_trace TEXT,
+            log_part TEXT,
+            log_idle_msecs INTEGER,
+            log_mark INTEGER,
+            log_comment TEXT,
+            log_tags TEXT,
+            log_annotations TEXT,
+            log_filters TEXT,
+            log_path TEXT,
+            log_text TEXT,
+            log_body TEXT,
+            col_0 TEXT,
+            col_1 TEXT,
+            col_2 TEXT,
+            col_3 TEXT,
+            col_4 TEXT,
+            col_5 TEXT,
+            col_6 TEXT,
+            col_7 TEXT,
+            col_8 TEXT,
+            col_9 TEXT
+        )
+        """
+    )
+    db.execute(
+        """
+        CREATE TABLE generic_log (
+            log_line INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+            log_time TEXT,
+            log_level TEXT,
+            log_part TEXT,
+            log_idle_msecs INTEGER,
+            log_mark INTEGER,
+            log_comment TEXT,
+            log_tags TEXT,
+            log_annotations TEXT,
+            log_filters TEXT,
+            log_path TEXT,
+            log_text TEXT,
+            log_body TEXT,
+            col_0 TEXT,
+            col_1 TEXT,
+            col_2 TEXT,
+            col_3 TEXT,
+            col_4 TEXT,
+            col_5 TEXT,
+            col_6 TEXT,
+            col_7 TEXT,
+            col_8 TEXT,
+            col_9 TEXT
+        )
+        """
+    )
+    db.execute(
+        """
+        CREATE TABLE syslog_log (
+            log_line INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
+            log_time TEXT,
+            log_level TEXT,
+            log_part TEXT,
+            log_idle_msecs INTEGER,
+            log_mark INTEGER,
+            log_comment TEXT,
+            log_tags TEXT,
+            log_annotations TEXT,
+            log_filters TEXT,
+            log_path TEXT,
+            log_text TEXT,
+            log_body TEXT,
+            col_0 TEXT,
+            col_1 TEXT,
+            col_2 TEXT,
+            col_3 TEXT,
+            col_4 TEXT,
+            col_5 TEXT,
+            col_6 TEXT,
+            col_7 TEXT,
+            col_8 TEXT,
+            col_9 TEXT
+        )
+        """
+    )
+    rows = visible_logs(state)
+    for index, record in enumerate(rows):
+        db.execute(
+            """
+            INSERT INTO all_logs VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
+            """,
+            (
+                index,
+                record.timestamp.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f"),
+                record.level,
+                record.body,
+                "null",
+                None,
+                None,
+                None,
+                record.idle_msecs,
+                0,
+                None,
+                None,
+                None,
+                None,
+                record.source_label,
+                record.display_text,
+                record.body,
+                *record.tokens,
+            ),
+        )
+        if record.format_name == "generic":
+            db.execute(
+                """
+                INSERT INTO generic_log VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
+                """,
+                (
+                    index,
+                    record.timestamp.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f"),
+                    record.level,
+                    None,
+                    record.idle_msecs,
+                    0,
+                    None,
+                    None,
+                    None,
+                    None,
+                    record.source_label,
+                    record.display_text,
+                    record.body,
+                    *record.tokens,
+                ),
+            )
+        if record.format_name == "syslog":
+            db.execute(
+                """
+                INSERT INTO syslog_log VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
+                """,
+                (
+                    index,
+                    record.timestamp.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%f"),
+                    record.level,
+                    None,
+                    record.idle_msecs,
+                    0,
+                    None,
+                    None,
+                    None,
+                    None,
+                    record.source_label,
+                    record.display_text,
+                    record.body,
+                    *record.tokens,
+                ),
+            )
+    if rows:
+        db.execute("CREATE VIEW logline AS SELECT * FROM all_logs ORDER BY log_line LIMIT 1")
+    return db
+

+def render_schema(state: State) -> str:
+    db = build_db(state)
+    rows = db.execute("SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE sql IS NOT NULL ORDER BY name").fetchall()
+    return "\n".join(row[0] + ";" for row in rows) + ("\n" if rows else "")
+
+
+def render_state(state: State) -> str:
+    if state.active_view == "explicit":
+        return state.explicit_output or ""
+    if state.active_view == "help":
+        return INTERNAL_HELP
+    if state.active_view == "query":
+        return render_query_result(state.query_result or QueryResult([], []))
+    if state.active_view == "text":
+        lines = visible_text_lines(state)
+        return "\n".join(lines) + ("\n" if lines else "")
+    if state.active_view == "log":
+        rows = visible_logs(state)
+        return "\n".join(record.display_text for record in rows) + ("\n" if rows else "")
+    return ""
+
+
+def render_query_result(result: QueryResult) -> str:
+    if not result.columns:
+        return ""
+    widths = [len(column) for column in result.columns]
+    rendered_rows: List[List[str]] = []
+    numeric = [True] * len(result.columns)
+    for row in result.rows:
+        cells: List[str] = []

+    matched = False
+    for line in lines:
+        parsed = parser(line)
+        if parsed is None:
+            if current is not None and line:
+                current.display_text += "\n" + line
+                current.body += "\n" + line

+                return []
+            continue
+        matched = True
+        timestamp, body, level = parsed
+        current = LogRecord(kind, timestamp, line, body, level, source.label, source.absolute_path, extract_tokens(body))
+        records.append(current)

+def parse_generic_line(line: str) -> Optional[tuple[datetime, str, str]]:
+    match = ISO_RE.match(line)
+    if not match:
+        return None
+    timestamp = parse_timestamp(match.group("stamp"))
+    if timestamp is None:
+        return None
+    return timestamp, match.group("body"), "unknown"

+def parse_syslog_line(line: str) -> Optional[tuple[datetime, str, str]]:
+    match = SYSLOG_RE.match(line)

+        return None
+    month = MONTHS.get(match.group("month"))
+    if month is None:
+        return None
+    timestamp = datetime(
+        date.today().year,
+        month,
+        int(match.group("day")),
+        int(match.group("hour")),
+        int(match.group("minute")),
+        int(match.group("second")),
+    )
+    body = match.group("body")
+    if ": " in body:
+        body = body.split(": ", 1)[1]
+    return timestamp, body, "info"

+            return datetime.strptime(raw, "%Y-%m-%d")
+        except ValueError:
+            return None

+    if re.search(r"[+-]\d{4}$", candidate):
+        candidate = candidate[:-5] + candidate[-5:-2] + ":" + candidate[-2:]

+        parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(candidate)
+    except ValueError:
+        return None
+    if parsed.tzinfo is not None:
+        parsed = parsed.astimezone().replace(tzinfo=None)

+        "warning": "warning",
+        "err": "error",
+        "error": "error",
+        "debug": "debug",
+        "trace": "trace",
+        "info": "info",

+        "warning": "WARNING",

+    if since is not None:
